newsitem.title: USA: Hanover Direct completes rights offering.
newsitem.headline: Hanover Direct completes rights offering.

text.p: Hanover Direct Inc said Monday it has completed its $50 million shareholder rights offering.
Under the offering, 48,748,785 new common shares were issued, bringing to 142,044,492 the total number of common shares outstanding.

The proceeds will be used to pay the principal and interest on 9.25 percent senior subordinated notes due on August 1, 1998, held by an affiliate of NAR Group Limited, the company's majority shareholder.

About a month after it was begun, holders of the company's common stock, excluding the board of directors and NAR Group Limited, the company's majority shareholder, had purchased 14,734,790 common shares.
Holders of Hanover Direct's 6 percent Series A convertible additional preferred stock and Series B convertible additional preferred stock purchased a total of 291,276 common shares.
Members of the board of directors purchased a total of 2,807,889 common shares.
NAR Group Limited received 24,015,964 rights entitling it to purchase approximately 50 percent of the shares offered in the rights offering, which it has exercised.
In addition, NAR has exercised all unsubscribed rights, purchasing an additional 6,898,866 common shares.
Following these purchases, NAR has increased to 78,004,954 shares, or 54.9 percent, its holdings in the Hanover Direct.
